messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find the dataset titled The CFS’s (Center for Financial Studies) historical money and capital market data base, Germany 1871 to 1914.?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Center for Financial Studies historical money capital market database Germany 1871 1914

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"The CFS’s (Center for Financial Studies) Historical Money and Capital Market Database, Germany 1871 to 1914","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.8286","justification":"Exact match for the requested dataset. Published by GESIS Data Archive in 2008 (dataset identifier ZA8286), it contains historical German money and capital market data covering 1871–1914. Developed by the Center for Financial Studies at Goethe University Frankfurt, it includes more than 100,000 bond market observations and extensive stock market data from six major German financial centers: Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Leipzig, Cologne, and Munich. This DOI is the dataset's official persistent identifier."},{"title":"Die historische Geld- und Kapitaldatenbank des Center for Financial Studies","url_or_doi":"https://fif.safe-frankfurt.de/xmlui/handle/123456789/58","justification":"Original institutional repository containing the historical financial database developed by the Center for Financial Studies at Goethe University Frankfurt. This landing page provides downloadable Excel datasets for the six German stock exchanges, along with documentation in PDF and Word formats. It covers 1871–1914 and includes approximately 700,000 stock market observations and more than 100,000 bond market observations. Particularly useful for directly accessing the underlying data files."},{"title":"The CFS’s Historical Money and Capital Market Database, Germany 1871 to 1914 — B2FIND","url_or_doi":"https://b2find.eudat.eu/dataset/024db9da-c71d-5538-a7df-40bdf53f3c9d","justification":"European research data catalog record matching the requested dataset title exactly. Provides comprehensive metadata, including the dataset description, creators, geographical coverage, historical period, publication information, and official DOI. Identifies GESIS Data Archive as the publisher and confirms that the dataset is available for academic research and teaching."},{"title":"Historische Geld- und Kapitalmarktdatenbank — BERD@NFDI","url_or_doi":"https://long-term.berd-nfdi.de/s/data/item/39","justification":"Research data catalog entry documenting the same historical German financial database for 1871–1914. Describes monthly share prices, share capital, and dividend information for companies listed on six major German stock exchanges. Provides information about the dataset's structure, Excel files, supporting documentation, publisher, and licensing."}]}
